title: One year in: How Microsoft Research Asia – Singapore is advancing research, partnership and talent for real-world impact
author: Microsoft Research Team
summary_raw: Since launching a year ago, the Microsoft Research Asia — Singapore lab has established a strong foundation, deepened collaboration across government, academia, and industry, and explored how frontier AI research can create real-world value.
